instruction: A woven basket: a rounded open vessel with a visible over-under woven wall pattern, a slightly irregular rolled rim, two handle attachment points (or a woven handle), and realistic wall thickness. Natural wicker tones.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a woven basket. A woven basket: a rounded open vessel with a visible over-under woven wall pattern, a slightly irregular rolled rim, two handle attachment points (or a woven handle), and realistic wall thickness. Natural wicker tones. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
